svg.aria-label: The same six noisy observations with RBF length scales 0.4, 1.2 and 3. Blue bands are latent-function and pale orange bands future-observation pointwise 95% intervals; the dotted curve is generating sin(x). Kernel amplitude one, noise standard deviation 0.15, fixed hyperparameters.
